URA3.description: Orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase. Auxotrophic marker for uracil prototrophy. Counterselectable with 5-FOA.
URA3.counterselection: 5-fluoroorotic acid (5-FOA) — cells retaining URA3 are killed
URA3.notes: Most widely used yeast marker; enables pop-in/pop-out strategies.

LEU2.description: Beta-isopropylmalate dehydrogenase. Auxotrophic marker for leucine prototrophy.

HIS3.description: Imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase. Auxotrophic marker for histidine prototrophy.

TRP1.description: Phosphoribosylanthranilate isomerase. Auxotrophic marker for tryptophan prototrophy.

kanMX.description: Kanamycin/G418 resistance cassette. Dominant selectable marker; works in any yeast background.
kanMX.notes: Preferred for wild-type or prototrophic yeast strains.

hygMX.description: Hygromycin B resistance cassette. Dominant selectable marker.

NPTII.description: Neomycin phosphotransferase II. Confers kanamycin/G418 resistance in plants.

HPT.description: Hygromycin phosphotransferase. Confers hygromycin resistance. Used in pCAMBIA vectors.

BAR.description: Bialaphos resistance (phosphinothricin acetyltransferase). Confers resistance to glufosinate/Basta. Common in monocot transformation.
BAR.notes: Preferred for wheat, maize, rice biolistics

PAT.description: Phosphinothricin acetyltransferase (same function as BAR, different source)
